description: Source code implementing a hardware-based pseudo-random number generator function 'raw_truerand' with platform-specific timing and signal handling, including functions for generating and mixing entropy from clock skew and OS events.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Sets a timer interval for generating entropy based on clock skew.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGALRM to control timing and entropy collection.

methods.name: roulette
methods.description: Collects entropy by timing loops and mixes bits to produce a pseudo-random value.

methods.name: raw_truerand
methods.description: Main function that calls 'roulette' multiple times to generate a high-entropy random number.
